At December 31, 2020, this plan accounted for 77% of our consolidated defined benefit pension plans' projected benefit obligation and 86% of the related plans' assets. In 2020, Corning made $180 million in voluntary contributions to our domestic defined benefit pension plan and cash contributions of $41 million to our international pension plans. During 2021, the Company anticipates making cash contributions of $31 million to the international pension plans.
